common.footer: You receive this email because you use {product}.
common.security_footer: This is a security email about your {product} account: it is sent even if you turned off other emails.
common.ignore: If you did not expect this email you can ignore it.
common.button_fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:

magic_link.subject: Your {product} sign-in link
magic_link.intro: Use this link to sign in. It expires in {minutes} minutes and works once.
magic_link.hint: If you did not ask to sign in, ignore this email: nobody can enter without the link.

email_change_confirm.subject: Confirm your new email address
email_change_confirm.intro: Someone asked to use this address for a {product} account. Confirm to complete the change: the link expires in {hours} hours.
email_change_confirm.hint: If it was not you, ignore this email: the account keeps its current address.

email_change_notice.subject: Your {product} email address is changing
email_change_notice.intro: A change of the sign-in address of your account to {email} was requested. Nothing changes until the new address confirms.
email_change_notice.hint: If it was not you, sign in and change your password, then cancel the request from your profile.

invite.subject: {inviter} invited you to {tenant} on {product} as {role}
invite.intro: {inviter} invited you to join {tenant} on {product} with the role {role}.
invite.hint: The invitation expires in {days} days and works once. If you did not expect it, ignore this email.

mention.subject: {author} mentioned you on {record}
mention.intro: {author} mentioned you in a note on {record}:

supplier_po.subject: Purchase order {po} from {company}
supplier_po.intro: Hello {supplier}, {company} sent you purchase order {po}. Please confirm it or tell us about any problem from the page below.
supplier_po.hint: The link is personal to this order.

digest.subject: Your daily summary for {tenant}
digest.preheader: What you have not read in the last 24 hours.

test.subject: {product} test email
test.intro: This is a test email sent from the {product} console. If you are reading it, the sender, the domain and the provider work.

welcome.subject: Welcome to {product}, {name}
welcome.intro: You now have access to {tenant} on {product}. A few things to start with:
welcome.profile: Complete your profile: photo, language, time zone and security notices.
welcome.guide: Connect your store and ad accounts with the integration guide.

password_reset.subject: Reset your {product} password
password_reset.intro: Someone asked to reset the password of your {product} account. Choose a new password with this link: it expires in {minutes} minutes and works once.
password_reset.hint: If it was not you, ignore this email: your password does not change.

password_changed.subject: Your {product} password was changed
password_changed.intro: The password of your {product} account was changed on {time}. Every other session was signed out.
password_changed.hint: If it was not you, reset your password from the sign-in page at once and contact support.

email_changed.subject: Your {product} sign-in address was changed
email_changed.intro: The sign-in address of your {product} account is now {email}. This address will no longer receive account emails.
email_changed.hint: If it was not you, contact support at once.

new_sign_in.subject: New sign-in to your {product} account
new_sign_in.intro: Your {product} account was just used to sign in from a device or browser we had not seen before:
new_sign_in.hint: If it was you, there is nothing to do. If not, change your password and sign out of the other sessions from your profile. You can turn these emails off on your profile.

account_disabled.subject: Your access to {tenant} was disabled
account_disabled.intro: An administrator of {tenant} disabled your access on {product}. You can no longer open that workspace.
account_disabled.hint: If you think this is a mistake, contact an administrator of {tenant}.

carrier_instruction.subject: Delivery instruction for parcel {tracking} ({company})
carrier_instruction.intro: Hello, {company} sends an instruction for parcel {tracking} (order {order}, carrier {carrier}).
carrier_instruction.new_address: Please deliver to this new address:
carrier_instruction.pickup_point: Please hold the parcel at this pickup point:
carrier_instruction.return: Please return the parcel to the sender.
carrier_instruction.hint: Please reply to this email to confirm.

system.stock_critical_no_po: {title} selling variants at critical stock with nothing on order
system.late_to_ship: {title} orders still to ship after {body} working days
system.export_ready: Your CSV export is ready: {title} rows ({body})
